title: Build a filter portfolio, not one quality score
description: Adjust score and size thresholds, then apply a governance policy. The model keeps eligible volume, safety removals, duplicates, provenance coverage, and slice retention visible as separate decisions.

cohorts.label: Studio and catalog photography
cohorts.detail: Polished, high-resolution product and editorial-style images with concise captions.

cohorts.label: Everyday mobile scenes
cohorts.detail: Informal real-world photos with varied lighting, composition, devices, and caption quality.

cohorts.label: Multilingual local scenes
cohorts.detail: Region-specific places and activities whose captions are not primarily English.

cohorts.label: Diagrams, screenshots, and documents
cohorts.detail: Information-dense images that can be useful for reasoning despite lower predicted visual appeal.

cohorts.label: Illustration and digital art
cohorts.detail: Highly stylized work with strong aesthetic scores and material authorship and licensing questions.

cohorts.label: Small web assets
cohorts.detail: Thumbnails, icons, and compressed media with useful concepts but limited source resolution.

policies.label: Score and size thresholds only
policies.detail: Selects by modeled aesthetics, alignment, and resolution without safety, deduplication, or provenance controls.

policies.label: Safety filters plus deduplication
policies.detail: Applies a separate policy stage and removes modeled duplicate-equivalent pairs while preserving rows with missing source context.

policies.label: Reviewable research manifest
policies.detail: Applies safety and deduplication, then holds pairs without recorded source context for separate review.
